# First, sort the dataframe by year to ensure we have chronological order
df_sorted = df.sort_values('year')

# Get the last two competitions (largest two years)
last_two_years = df_sorted['year'].nlargest(2).values
last_two_df = df_sorted[df_sorted['year'].isin(last_two_years)]

# Extract the distance values from the 'notes' column for these two competitions
# The distance is the numeric part before ' m' in the notes column
distances = last_two_df['notes'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)')[0].astype(float)

# Calculate the average of these distances
average_distance = distances.mean()

# Check if the average is equal to 78.27 m (with possible floating point tolerance)
answer = abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-9
